data.narrative:
AGent Energy is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Stephanie Hendricks, François Parker, and Todd Krause that has raised $6M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix, though none share sufficiently similar stage or valuation characteristics to support a reliable peer median approach.

The valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: Stage-Progression. Using total capital raised as a proxy base of $6M and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $15M. Peer-Median triangulation was not feasible given the absence of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables within the narrow peer set—eight same-sector companies exist but none met the minimum three-datapoint threshold for a meaningful cohort analysis.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, with a median point of $15M. This estimate carries material uncertainty owing to reliance on a single methodological input. Key risk factors include the nascent stage of the company, limited public pricing data in the sector, and the absence of directly comparable Seed-round transactions in Climate & Energy. A refreshed analysis would benefit from additional Seed-stage or Series A transaction data within or adjacent to the sector.
